# Wattpad

> > Wattpad is a global social storytelling platform where millions of readers and writers discover, share, and engage with user-generated fiction across diverse genres.

Wattpad hosts one of the world's largest online communities for original stories, featuring programs like Wattpad Originals for premium content and The Wattys awards celebrating outstanding writers. The platform enables social reading experiences where users can comment, vote, and connect with authors in real-time.
